purpose: Include another fact in addition to the first.
keywords: Plain form + だけでなく; noun + だけでなく; な-adjective + なだけでなく
This park is not only spacious but also quiet.
Not only my mother but also my father is good at cooking.
This tool is not only useful but also durable.
formation: Plain form + だけでなく; noun + だけでなく; な-adjective + なだけでなく
restrictions: Often pair the second item with も to make the addition clear.
mistake: Use な before だけ with a な-adjective, but not with an ordinary noun.
